workflowDefinition.name: Argus Trust Gate (Phase 3)
workflowDefinition.description:
Argus Phase 3 — non-invasive trust policy gate.
Sits BETWEEN the @kbn/evals pass signal and the autonomous applier. For every recommendation that is `auto_apply_ready`, the gate:

  1. Looks up the producing actor in `.soc-actor-trust-tiers`.
  2. If the actor's tier policy says `auto_apply == false` (probationary
     or quarantined), downgrades the rec to `pending_review` and
     annotates it with `rejection_reason = trust_policy_gate` so the
     Autonomy Feed surfaces it.
  3. For tiers that allow auto-apply, enforces the frontier-class
     cap: frontier-class origins (exploit_to_detection, drift_detected)
     only pass for `tier == frontier`; other origins pass for
     `frontier` and `trusted`.

The gate is DELIBERATELY NON-INVASIVE — it only rewrites the status + `rejection_reason`. Applier still owns ownership, budget, kill switch, cooldown, loop, and snapshot gating. This keeps the cascade composable and lets us roll the gate forward/back independently.
Triggers:
  * scheduled 2m  : frequent enough to catch auto_apply_ready recs
                    before the applier's next sweep
  * manual        : demo operators can force a sweep

with.message: {%- assign _n = steps.find_actor_tier.output.hits.hits | size | default: 0 -%} {% if _n > 0 %}yes{% else %}no{% endif %}

document.content: rec {{ foreach.item._id }} actor={{ foreach.item._source.source | default: 'unknown' }} tier={{ steps.find_actor_tier.output.hits.hits[0]._source.tier | default: 'unknown' }} verdict={{ steps.compute_gate_verdict.output }}

with.message: Argus trust gate complete — gated={{ steps.fetch_candidates.output.hits.hits | size | default: 0 }} tick=argus-trust-gate-{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%Y%m%d%H%M%S' }}

_source.yaml:
version: '1'
name: Argus Trust Gate (Phase 3)
description: >
  Argus Phase 3 — non-invasive trust policy gate.

  Sits BETWEEN the @kbn/evals pass signal and the autonomous applier.
  For every recommendation that is `auto_apply_ready`, the gate:

    1. Looks up the producing actor in `.soc-actor-trust-tiers`.
    2. If the actor's tier policy says `auto_apply == false` (probationary
       or quarantined), downgrades the rec to `pending_review` and
       annotates it with `rejection_reason = trust_policy_gate` so the
       Autonomy Feed surfaces it.
    3. For tiers that allow auto-apply, enforces the frontier-class
       cap: frontier-class origins (exploit_to_detection, drift_detected)
       only pass for `tier == frontier`; other origins pass for
       `frontier` and `trusted`.

  The gate is DELIBERATELY NON-INVASIVE — it only rewrites the status
  + `rejection_reason`. Applier still owns ownership, budget, kill
  switch, cooldown, loop, and snapshot gating. This keeps the cascade
  composable and lets us roll the gate forward/back independently.

  Triggers:
    * scheduled 2m  : frequent enough to catch auto_apply_ready recs
                      before the applier's next sweep
    * manual        : demo operators can force a sweep

enabled: true

triggers:
  - type: scheduled
    with:
      every: 2m
  - type: manual

consts:
  recs_index: ".soc-recommendations"
  tiers_index: ".soc-actor-trust-tiers"

steps:
  # ── Fetch auto_apply_ready recs the gate has not yet scored ─────────
  - name: fetch_candidates
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: "{{ consts.recs_index }}"
      size: 50
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - term: { status: "auto_apply_ready" }
          must_not:
            - exists: { field: "trust_gate_decision" }

  - name: gate_each_rec
    type: foreach
    foreach: "{{ steps.fetch_candidates.output.hits.hits }}"
    steps:
      # elasticsearch.request (not .search) so we can use object-form
      # sort on @timestamp — the engine's .search schema rejects it.
      - name: find_actor_tier
        type: elasticsearch.request
        with:
          method: POST
          path: "/{{ consts.tiers_index }}/_search"
          body:
            size: 1
            query:
              bool:
                filter:
                  - term: { actor_id: "{{ foreach.item._source.source | default: 'unknown' }}" }
            sort:
              - "@timestamp":
                  order: desc

      - name: has_tier_gate
        type: console
        with:
          message: >-
            {%- assign _n = steps.find_actor_tier.output.hits.hits | size | default: 0 -%}
            {% if _n > 0 %}yes{% else %}no{% endif %}

      - name: compute_gate_verdict
        type: console
        with:
          message: >-
            {%- assign _n = steps.find_actor_tier.output.hits.hits | size | default: 0 -%}
            {%- if _n == 0 -%}pending_review
            {%- else -%}
              {%- assign tier = steps.find_actor_tier.output.hits.hits[0]._source.tier | default: 'quarantined' -%}
              {%- assign origin = foreach.item._source.argus.origin | default: 'analyst' -%}
              {%- if tier == 'quarantined' -%}rejected_trust
              {%- elsif tier == 'probationary' -%}pending_review
              {%- elsif tier == 'trusted' -%}
                {%- if origin == 'exploit_to_detection' or origin == 'drift_detected' -%}pending_review
                {%- else -%}allow
                {%- endif -%}
              {%- elsif tier == 'frontier' -%}allow
              {%- else -%}pending_review
              {%- endif -%}
            {%- endif -%}

      - name: annotate_rec_for_downgrade
        type: elasticsearch.update
        if: "steps.compute_gate_verdict.output != 'allow'"
        with:
          index: "{{ consts.recs_index }}"
          id: "{{ foreach.item._id }}"
          doc:
            status: "{{ steps.compute_gate_verdict.output }}"
            trust_gate_decision: "{{ steps.compute_gate_verdict.output }}"
            trust_gate_tier: "{{ steps.find_actor_tier.output.hits.hits[0]._source.tier | default: 'unknown' }}"
            trust_gate_checked_at: "{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%LZ' }}"
            trust_gate_tick: "argus-trust-gate-{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%Y%m%d%H%M%S' }}"
            rejection_reason: "trust_policy_gate"

      - name: annotate_rec_for_allow
        type: elasticsearch.update
        if: "steps.compute_gate_verdict.output: allow"
        with:
          index: "{{ consts.recs_index }}"
          id: "{{ foreach.item._id }}"
          doc:
            trust_gate_decision: "allow"
            trust_gate_tier: "{{ steps.find_actor_tier.output.hits.hits[0]._source.tier | default: 'unknown' }}"
            trust_gate_checked_at: "{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%LZ' }}"
            trust_gate_tick: "argus-trust-gate-{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%Y%m%d%H%M%S' }}"

      - name: write_gate_trace
        type: elasticsearch.index
        with:
          index: .soc-reasoning-trace
          document:
            "@timestamp": "{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%LZ' }}"
            run_id: "argus-trust-gate-{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%Y%m%d%H%M%S' }}"
            agent_id: "soc-argus-trust-gate"
            step_index: 0
            step_type: "run_summary"
            content: "rec {{ foreach.item._id }} actor={{ foreach.item._source.source | default: 'unknown' }} tier={{ steps.find_actor_tier.output.hits.hits[0]._source.tier | default: 'unknown' }} verdict={{ steps.compute_gate_verdict.output }}"
            argus:
              agent:
                id: "soc-argus-trust-gate"
                version: "argus-phase3"
              decision:
                kind: "trust_gate"
                id: "{{ foreach.item._id }}"
                confidence: 1.0
              actor:
                trust_tier: "{{ steps.find_actor_tier.output.hits.hits[0]._source.tier | default: 'unknown' }}"
            attributes:
              argus.agent.id: "soc-argus-trust-gate"
              argus.agent.version: "argus-phase3"
              argus.decision.kind: "trust_gate"
              argus.decision.id: "{{ foreach.item._id }}"
              argus.decision.confidence: 1.0
              argus.actor.trust_tier: "{{ steps.find_actor_tier.output.hits.hits[0]._source.tier | default: 'unknown' }}"

  # ── Heartbeat ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  - name: heartbeat
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-audit-trail
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%LZ' }}"
        event_type: argus_trust_gate_tick
        source: "soc-argus-trust-gate"
        tick_id: "argus-trust-gate-{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%Y%m%d%H%M%S' }}"
        gated_count: "{{ steps.fetch_candidates.output.hits.hits | size | default: 0 }}"

  - name: log_done
    type: console
    with:
      message: "Argus trust gate complete — gated={{ steps.fetch_candidates.output.hits.hits | size | default: 0 }} tick=argus-trust-gate-{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%Y%m%d%H%M%S' }}"
